issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int on SealSaloon (see UML and text). The reference implementation instead provides a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java. Additionally, the commented-out Main in the solution refers to calculateTotalPrice, creating an internal name mismatch. This naming inconsistency between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the correct method name/signature they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name/signature across artifacts. Either rename the solution method computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (keeping it static and returning int), and update all usages in Main and comments, or adjust the problem statement/UML to require computeMealCost(Meal) instead of calculateTotalPrice. Ensure the template, solution, and problem text consistently reference the same method name and signature.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to compute the net cost of a meal, but the reference implementation defines this functionality as computeMealCost(Meal). Additionally, example usages across the template and solution Main files are inconsistent (some call computeMealCost, others call calculateTotalPrice). This name divergence for the same core operation (computing a meal's total price) creates mapping confusion for students: they may search for calculateTotalPrice as required by the exercise but find computeMealCost in the provided code (or vice versa).
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent name for the meal-price calculation across all artifacts. Rename the implementation method computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (and keep it static as required), and update all example calls in Main and any other files to call calculateTotalPrice. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to use computeMealCost if that name is preferred — but ensure all files (template, solution, and problem text) use the same identifier.
